name: Asahina Rinka
source:
A girl who works part time at the same convenience store as [url=http://vndb.org/c2577]Akito[/url], and, having known him for about a year, considers him a friend. She's a great driver but doesn't know much else about cars, and has a terrible memory for the roads she travels - making him a perfect match for her as navigator.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/moero2/]official English site[/url]]
